notes.title: New VN 'Thawing Feelings' on Kickstarter now!
notes.content:
Want to play our latest visual novel? It's coming soon!
Click on the picture below, or this link here, to be taken to our newest Kickstarter campaign page for our upcoming VN, Thawing Feelings!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ds-sans/thawing-feelings-adult-visual-novel][img]https://i.postimg.cc/GcMdttf4/cover-ks.png[/img][/url]

Thawing Feelings will be a contemporary take on the traditional, romantic visual novel. The game will include a rich and atmospheric story and provide a realistic look at relationship and identity struggles during young adulthood, including sensual adult scenes and a story driven narrative.

Please look forward to it!

notes.title: Chemically Bonded Summer Sale!
notes.content:
*splash* 💦

What's that? Chemically Bonded is on sale for the cheapest it's ever been, and there's a thumbnail of two cute anime girls at the beach to tell you about it?

Yes, and despite cheesy introductions, you can now buy (if you haven't) or get your friends to buy Chemically Bonded for 50% off during the summer sale! Isn't that fun?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/734900/

Now that's out of the way, we'd like to talk about future updates to Chemically Bonded and our other titles.

As you know, we released our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/734900/view/2202769156565262891]Sae-entific ♥ Hearts[/url] update last month! The reception to that was amazing and really inspires us to keep Chemically Bonded going with new updates and fun every now and then.

We are however, working on a new visual novel that we're actively developing and we'd like to tell you more about that. 'Thawing Feelings' is a new romantic VN set within the depths of winter and will be very similar to Chemically Bonded, albeit more mature in its nature. [url=https://twitter.com/dssansVN]If you're interested, please check us out on Twitter and keep tuned for updates about it and our upcoming Kickstarter campaign.[/url]

On that note, we'd like to wish you a merry summer - we'll have more updates here periodically as we continue to maintain the game and work on more cute anime girl picture books. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Nfsw-G3qT/beach.png[/img]

notes.title: Sae-entific ♥ Hearts Update Out Now!
notes.content:
Sae is back by popular demand!

We heard you all loud and clear, you want to spend time with everyone's favourite purple princess - Sae [SURNAME REDACTED]. Well, now you can! We've added an additional scene to Chemically Bonded's 'bonus' menu, which we hope will cover up some lose ends.

To access this new content, first complete both Kiyoko's and Naomi's good endings (because low-effort attempts at romancing her aren't going to work), and play the new update from the bonus menu!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/J19g2mpy/screenshot0027.png[/img]

We hope you'll enjoy this new update, please give Sae all the love she deserves! A big thank you goes out to her VA, Taylor Faye, who has done yet another brilliant job in this role, especially on such a short notice.

---

In other news, we've also fixed a few issues. Chemically Bonded is now on ver 1.1.1! We'll be updating the game again very soon with more fixes, to bring the game to a 1.1.2 release this week.

ICYMI: [url=https://twitter.com/dssansVN/status/1259966593540464642]We've also announced our next adventure on Twitter![/url] If you liked Chemically Bonded and want to see more from us, please check it out! More news about our new title 'Thawing Feelings' will be coming soon.

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 out now!
notes.content:
We're back!

Thank you all for the support over the last few months! We're happy that Chemically Bonded has been received well.

As Valentine's day is almost upon us, we decided to give you a gift in the form of a few new fixes and surprises in our 1.1.0 patch:

- Fixed an issue where a 'missing image' error appeared at the start of Kiyoko's Act 3.
- Fixed more typos and text errors.
- Updated text on the main menu.

We also added in an easter egg for y'all on the main menu! See if you can find it! (And no, it's not our Twitter we stuck on there.)

Thank you! If you're enjoying the game, feel free to provide feedback to us too. That'll certainly keep us company on Valentine's day.

notes.title: 1.0.4c Patch
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're all enjoying Chemically Bonded after its first week on sale. We were made aware of a few minor issues with the release build (1.0.4b) which we have since updated in the 1.0.4c patch below:

- Made intro video skippable.
- Fixed issues where some audio lines did not match dialogue. 
- Corrected a few typos.
- Squashed a few stinky bugs (one or two side images were not displaying properly in Act 3).

While Kiyoko would rather us pick the bugs up with a cup and take them outside, it's essential for us to keep Chemically Bonded at the quality you expect and that you've paid for. If anyone encounters any further issues with the game, please report them to us and we will address the issue promptly.

Thank you to '[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Supi444]Supi =DYMC=[/url]' for alerting us to these issues.

If you're enjoying the game, follow us on Twitter for updates on future projects: https://twitter.com/dssansVN
